look: Quartzback Hound, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Quartzbacks family: lean wolf with frost-quartz spines and rime on its paws. Family anatomy: wolves with frost-quartz spines along the back and pale icy fur. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are frost-white quartz. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, small subtle ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
